limitations: Same-author probes written following the candidate commit. Score source admission before packing.

documents.name: press-bins.md
documents.text: Operators must pack press bins before storage.

documents.name: wheel-guards.md
documents.text: Operators must buff wheel guards after storage.

documents.name: specimen-jars.md
documents.text: Specimen jars must be chilled before labeling and packed after labeling.

documents.name: labels-and-sleeves.md
documents.text: Labels must be kept flat and sleeves stored upright after transit.

documents.name: service-call.md
documents.text: Dispatchers must record heater faults before calling maintenance.

documents.name: maintenance-work.md
documents.text: Dispatchers must record heater faults before maintenance.

documents.name: freezer-opening.md
documents.text: Staff must log freezer temperatures before opening.

documents.name: freezer-closing.md
documents.text: Staff must log freezer temperatures after closing.

documents.name: filter-cart.md
documents.text: Technicians must replace amber filters. Technicians must replace blue filters. Staff must wipe the cart after replacement.

documents.name: ink-tray.md
documents.text: Ink cartridge replacement takes place at the north station. Staff must wipe the tray after replacement.

documents.name: closures.md
documents.text: Operators must seal freight bags if the west gate closes.

documents.name: opening.md
documents.text: Operators must seal freight bags if the west gate opens.

rows.query: Explain the requirements to pack press bins before storage and buff wheel guards after storage.
Explain the requirement to pack specimen jars after labeling.
Explain the requirement to chill specimen jars after labeling.
Explain the requirement to store sleeves after transit.
Explain the requirement to record heater faults before calling maintenance.
Explain the requirement to log freezer temperatures before opening or after closing.
Explain the requirement to wipe the cart after replacing blue filters.
Explain the requirement to wipe the cart after replacing amber filters.
Explain the requirement to wipe the tray after replacing ink cartridges.
When the west gate closes, explain the requirement to seal freight bags.
